ENG: In my efforts to learn the [scheme.GetTargetCharacter.GetCulture.GetLanguage.GetNameNoTooltip] language, I keep plenty of notes since it tends to be too much to keep in my head. But now, when I need them, I can no longer find them! A quick search leaves me clueless as to their whereabouts.\n\nAs I turn around, I find myself looking down on [ROOT.Char.Custom('DogStoryName')], wagging [ROOT.Char.Custom('DogStoryHerHis')] tail and happy as a [ROOT.Char.Custom('GetAnimalType')]. It takes me a moment before I realize that [ROOT.Char.Custom('DogStorySheHe')] has got all of my notes firmly clenched between [ROOT.Char.Custom('DogStoryHerHis')] teeth...
RUS: Когда изучаешь [scheme.GetTargetCharacter.GetCulture.GetLanguage.GetNameNoTooltip|l] язык, держать все в голове слишком трудно, и я многое записываю.
